accessControl.deniedMessage: You do not have permission to access the Administration area. Contact your tenant administrator to request access.

hubIntro.title: Administration
hubIntro.description: Manage business pattern templates, review tenant planning session history, examine the immutable audit log, and administer user access for this tenant.

sectionTiles.title: Pattern Library
sectionTiles.description: Create and manage business pattern templates that guide the AI Planning Agent when matching session content to recommended ADSP service compositions.

sectionTiles.title: Session History
sectionTiles.description: Review all planning sessions conducted within this tenant. Filter by date range, user, or status and export results for governance reporting.

sectionTiles.title: Audit Log
sectionTiles.description: View the immutable HMAC-chained audit log of all administrative actions. Verify chain integrity and export records for compliance submissions.

sectionTiles.title: User Management
sectionTiles.description: Assign and edit planner-service roles for users within this tenant. Invite users, modify role assignments, and deactivate access as required.

onLoad.description: Fetch pattern count for the Pattern Library tile stats badge. Uses page=1&pageSize=1 to retrieve total without full payload.
Fetch session count (tenant-scoped for admin role) for the Session History tile stats badge.
Fetch audit event count (last 30 days) for the Audit Log tile stats badge. Requires planner-admin role.

errorStates.display: Access denied message: 'You do not have permission to access the Administration area.'

errorStates.condition: stats badge load failure (network error or 503 from INT-002 stub)
errorStates.display: Tile renders without stats badge; loading indicator replaced with '--'. Tile navigation remains functional.

accessibility.keyboardNavigation: All section tiles are focusable and operable by keyboard. CTA buttons have descriptive aria-labels. Tile headings use heading hierarchy h2.
accessibility.contrastRequirement: Meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratio for all tile text and badge text on tile background.

metadata.securityNote: Admin-hub aggregate counts (pattern count, session count, audit event count) do not expose individual Protected B fields. Stats bindings return only numeric totals, not session content or personal data.
